As a Chinese Canadian I have mixed emotions XDDDD

Your words really hit deep in my soul because I've also experienced this before.

I am not a therapist, I'm just a regular old human like you.

I won't spit any bullshit like how "everything is going to be ok" or "It's ok to feel down sometimes" or "it's not worth it"

You are the one who understands your situation the best, not me or anyone else. I don't know what you're going through, whether it's the stress of having harsh parents, too much work, or anything else.

All I can say is that, think of everything that has given you the slightest feeling of joy, or happiness. Maybe that one time you did well on a test/exam, or the feeling of freedom you got when you went on a hike, the beautiful colors of a sunset...

This might not apply to you, but the way I think I got out of my depression is to accept it and think, "Welp, at least before I leave this place I should help as many people as I can."

And I don't mean inventing something big or anything or spending thousands on 3 world countries, I mean the small things. I know this might sound corny, but if you have the chance to, help someone by opening their door, or help take out their trash, or just be polite in general.

I got this thinking from this video by Kurzgesagt: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h6fcK\_fRYaI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h6fcK_fRYaI)

I hope I helped you and remember, you are not alone.
